name: journeymap-1.21.1-6.0.9+neoforge
changelog:
JourneyMap 1.21.1-6.0.9 for Minecraft 1.21.1

Requirements:

  • Java 21
  • Minecraft 1.21.1
  • NeoForge 21.1.228

General Information:

  • See http://journeymap.info for information about how to install and use this mod, rules about inclusion in modpacks, translation, etc.
  • See http://journeymap.info for information on getting technical support.
  • Implements JourneyMap API v2.0.0-1.21.1

CHANGELOG (2026-09-19-18:41:38):

New in 1.21.1-6.0.9

  • Fixed: Map not rendering when Dynamic Surroundings biome fog is enabled.
  • Fixed: Minimap Preset 2 cave layer slider only enabled when Preset 1 was set to Underground.
  • Fixed: Viewing minimap preset options switching the active preset and rewriting config files.
